Data: Holds up to 500 lb or 64 cubic feet in an extradimensional space while the bag itself weighs 15 lb. If overloaded, pierced, or torn, it is destroyed and its contents are scattered in the Astral Plane.
While wearing and attuned to the cloak, gain +1 AC. You also gain +1 to all saving throws.
While wearing and attuned to the ring, gain +1 AC. You also gain +1 to all saving throws.
Your footsteps make no sound while wearing these boots. You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks that rely on moving silently.

Your walking speed becomes 30 ft unless it is already higher, and heavy armor or encumbrance cannot reduce it. Your jump distance is tripled, but you still cannot jump farther than your remaining movement.
You have resistance to cold damage and ignore difficult terrain caused by ice or snow. You can tolerate temperatures down to -50°F without protection, or -100°F while wearing heavy clothes.
Gain darkvision out to 60 ft while wearing the goggles. If you already have darkvision, its range increases by 60 ft.
Your Strength score becomes 19 while wearing and attuned to the gauntlets. They have no effect if your Strength is already 19 or higher.
Your Intelligence score becomes 19 while wearing and attuned to the headband. It has no effect if your Intelligence is already 19 or higher.
Your Constitution score becomes 19 while wearing and attuned to the amulet. It has no effect if your Constitution is already 19 or higher.
While wearing and attuned to it, you automatically stabilize whenever you are dying at the start of your turn. Whenever you roll a Hit Die to regain HP, double the HP restored.
Once per dawn, use an action to speak its command word and regain one expended spell slot of 3rd level or lower. You must be attuned to the pearl to use it.

Has 7 charges; spend 1 charge to cast 1st-level Magic Missile, plus 1 extra charge for each higher spell level. Regains 1d6 + 1 charges at dawn; spending the last charge has a 1-in-20 chance to destroy the wand.
Has 7 charges; spend 1 charge as an action to cast Web with save DC 15. Regains 1d6 + 1 charges at dawn; spending the last charge has a 1-in-20 chance to destroy the wand.
While attuned, gain +1 to spell attack rolls made while holding the wand. Your spell attacks also ignore half cover.
While attuned and holding the rod, gain +1 to warlock spell attack rolls and warlock spell save DC. Once per long rest, use an action to regain one expended warlock spell slot.
While wearing this armor, any critical hit against you becomes a normal hit. The armor otherwise functions as its normal armor type.
This armor does not impose disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. If its normal armor type has a Strength requirement, the mithral version does not.
Gain +1 to attack rolls made with this magic weapon. On a hit, it also deals +1 damage.
Gain +2 to attack rolls made with this magic weapon. On a hit, it also deals +2 damage.
This magic shield gives +1 AC in addition to the shield's normal +2 AC. While wielded, it therefore provides +3 AC total.
This magic armor gives +1 AC in addition to the armor type's normal AC. All other properties of the base armor remain unchanged.
While attuned, you gain proficiency with shortbows and longbows. You also gain +2 damage on attacks made with either weapon.

Its three extradimensional compartments hold up to 60 arrows or bolts, 18 javelins, and 6 long objects such as bows, spears, or quarterstaffs. The quiver never weighs more than 2 lb, and items can be drawn normally.

Once per dawn, throw it at a target within 120 ft to create a 5-ft-wide lightning line; creatures in the line make a DC 13 Dex save or take 4d6 lightning damage, half on success. Then make the normal javelin attack against the target; on a hit, it also takes 4d6 lightning damage.
Press its button to lock the rod in place, even in midair, until the button is pressed again. It can hold up to 8,000 lb; greater force may move it after a DC 30 Strength check.

As an action, produce fresh or salt water: Stream 1 gal, Fountain 5 gal, or Geyser 30 gal in a 30-ft line. Geyser can target a creature within 30 ft: DC 13 Strength save or take 1d4 bludgeoning damage and fall prone; it can instead push an unattended object up to 15 ft.
One pint of oil burns for 6 hours, creating bright light for 30 ft and dim light for another 30 ft. Invisible creatures and objects are visible while inside the bright light.
This 60-ft rope can animate, move 10 ft per turn, fasten or unfasten itself, knot itself, and coil on command. When knotted it becomes 50 ft long and gives advantage on checks made to climb it.

Speak its command word while riding it to fly at 50 ft, or 30 ft while carrying over 200 lb; maximum load is 400 lb. It can also travel alone to a familiar destination within 1 mile and return when commanded, if still within 1 mile.
While attuned, gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed for up to 4 hours, used in increments of at least 1 minute. The boots regain 2 hours of flight for every 12 hours they are not used.

While its hood is up, creatures have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to see you. You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide, and raising or lowering the hood uses an action.
While wearing and attuned to the hat, you can cast Disguise Self at will. The spell ends immediately if the hat is removed.
While wearing the lenses, you have advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks relying on sight. The object or area being inspected must be within 1 ft of you.
While attuned and carrying the stone, gain +1 to all ability checks. You also gain +1 to all saving throws.
As an action, you and every creature and object within 10 ft become invisible for 2d4 minutes; the dust is consumed. A creature's invisibility ends early if that creature attacks or casts a spell.

Draw and throw a card within 30 ft to create a life-sized illusion of the creature shown on that card. The illusion looks and behaves real but cannot cause harm, and it lasts until dispelled or the card is moved.
Amulet of Proof against Detection and Location
While attuned and wearing the amulet, divination magic cannot target you or perceive you through magical scrying sensors.
While attuned and wearing the brooch, you have resistance to force damage and immunity to damage from Magic Missile.
While wearing the cap underwater, you can speak its command word to create a bubble of breathable air around your head until the command is spoken again, the cap is removed, or you leave the water.
Once per dawn, use an action to cast Scorching Ray from the circlet with a +5 attack bonus.
While wearing it with the hood up, you can breathe underwater and gain a swimming speed of 60 ft. Raising or lowering the hood uses an action.
Produces Light on command and can cast Daylight once per dawn. You can also command it to float and follow within 60 ft.
While attuned and wearing the lenses, you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight and can clearly see extremely distant details.
Has 50 charges. Spend charges to create bright light, fire a blinding beam at one creature, or emit a blinding cone; depleted gems become nonmagical.
Contains 1d4 + 1 doses. Applying one dose restores 2d8 + 2 HP and ends poison and any disease affecting the target.
Has 3 charges; spend 1 charge to cast Detect Thoughts, save DC 13. Regains 1d3 charges each dawn.
While attuned and wearing it, you can breathe normally in any environment and have advantage on saves against harmful gases and vapors.
While wearing it, you are immune to contracting diseases. Existing diseases are suppressed while the periapt is worn.
While attuned and wearing it, you are immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition.
While attuned and wearing the ring, you can cast Jump on yourself as a bonus action at will.
While attuned, you are immune to magic that reads thoughts, determines whether you are lying, or reveals your alignment or creature type. Telepathic communication works only if you allow it.
While wearing the ring, you can stand on and move across liquid surfaces as if they were solid ground.
While attuned and wearing them, you can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and ceilings while keeping your hands free, with climbing speed equal to walking speed.
Has 3 charges. Spend 1 charge to make the wand point toward the nearest secret door or trap within 30 ft; it regains 1d3 charges each dawn.
